title: Omugugu gw’ekirabo ekigaanibwa
intro: Mu ntandikwa y’ebyafaayo by’omuntu, ensi bwe yali ekyali nto era ng’ensi ekwata omukka gwayo ogusooka, emmeeme yayimirira mu maaso g’Omutonzi ng’ewaayo ekiweebwayo ekiwombeefu. Ekiweebwayo ekyo kyapimibwa mu minzaani y’okukkirizibwa okw’obwakatonda — era ne kizuulibwa nga kyabula. Ekyaddirira tekyali mboozi ya kusonyiwa, wabula ya mutima ogwali guweddewo obuggya, ne guviirako ekikolwa ekitakyuka ekyandiwulikika mu biseera byonna. Eno y’emboozi y’omuntu erinnya lye eryafuuka ekintu ekimu n’obutali bwenkanya obw’amaanyi obwasooka okukolebwa.
clues: Najja mu bulamu ng’omu ku baana abaasooka ennyo okuzaalibwa, abazaalibwa omuzadde emboozi ye gy’omanyi obulungi.
Lumu nawaayo ssaddaaka eri Allah, naye ne kitakkirizibwa okuva gyendi — newankubadde nga ekiweebwayo kya muganda wange kyafunibwa n’ekisa.
Obuggya n’obusungu byasimba emirandira mu mutima gwange, era ne ntiisatiisa okumalawo obulamu bw’ab’eŋŋanda zange.
Muganda wange yandabula okutya Allah, naye amalala gange tegaandeka kuwuliriza.
Mu kaseera ak’obunafu obw’entiisa, nnakola ekikolwa ekitayinza kwogerwa ku muganda wange yennyini.
Oluvannyuma, saamanya na kukweka bye nnali nkoze — okutuusa ekitonde ky’ensi lwe kyasindikibwa okunjigiriza.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
